modules.module_title: Collect required raw materials and tools for making final product

pcs.pc_description: Identify and plan the structure, artifacts, and decorative to be made.
Collect raw materials like wood, metal, glass, rubber, e-waste, plastic, and cloth waste.
Check and sort scraps and e-waste as per requirements.
Place raw materials at designated locations safely.
Collect tools (marker, ruler, cutters, welding machine, etc.) required for upcycling.
Place tools at designated locations safely.
Deliver remaining raw materials to storage locations.

modules.module_title: Follow safety measures while handling waste

pcs.pc_description: Handle all waste materials safely and securely.
Use PPE for tasks (e.g., goggles, gloves, face mask).
Maintain proper posture while lifting or working.

modules.module_title: Perform the process of upcycling scraps and e-waste

pcs.pc_description: Prepare and upcycle wood scraps by marking, cutting, sanding, and engraving the pieces, then assembling them into the required structure or decorative item, while checking the quality for modifications if necessary.
Prepare and upcycle metal scraps by marking, cutting, assembling, and welding the pieces into the required structure or decorative item, then checking the quality for modifications if necessary.
Prepare and upcycle glass scraps by marking, cutting, assembling pieces into the required structure or decorative item, and checking the quality for modifications if necessary.
Prepare and upcycle rubber scraps by marking, cutting, assembling, and joining pieces with industrial glue, and checking the quality of the final product.
Prepare and upcycle e-waste by marking, cutting, assembling pieces into structures, artifacts, or decorative, and checking the quality of the final product.
Prepare and upcycle plastic scraps by gathering, cleaning, shredding, and assembling pieces into structures, artifacts, or decorative using industrial glue.
Prepare and upcycle cloth scraps by collecting, cleaning, cutting, patching, sewing, adding embellishments, and checking the quality of the final product.
